items.source: String-based queries support parametrized queries. You can either use positional placeholders like “$1”, in which case each of the method parameters will map, in order, to $1, $2, $3…​ Alternatively, you can use named placeholders using the “$someString” syntax. Method parameters will be matched with their corresponding placeholder using the parameter’s name, which can be overridden by annotating each parameter (except a Pageable or Sort) with @Param (eg. @Param("someString")). You cannot mix the two approaches in your query and will get an IllegalArgumentException if you do.
items.translation: 基于字符串的查询支持参数化查询。您可以使用位置占位符（如"$1"），此时每个方法参数将按顺序映射到$1、$2、$3…；或者，您可以使用"$someString"语法来使用命名占位符。 方法参数将通过参数名称与其对应的占位符进行匹配。您可以通过为每个参数（除Pageable或Sort外）添加@Param注解来覆盖该名称（例如@Param("someString")）。 您不能在查询中混合使用这两种方法，否则将抛出IllegalArgumentException异常。

items.source: You can also do single projections in your N1QL queries (provided it selects only one field and returns only one result, usually an aggregation like COUNT, AVG, MAX…​). Such projection would have a simple return type like long, boolean or String. This is NOT intended for projections to DTOs.
items.translation: 在 N1QL 查询中，您也可以执行单列投影（前提是仅选择一个字段并返回单个结果，通常是聚合函数如 COUNT、AVG、MAX…）。 此类投影具有简单的返回类型，例如 long、boolean 或 String。 此功能不适用于将结果投影到 DTO（数据传输对象）。

This will produce a query looking like this: SELECT …​ FROM …​ WHERE firstName = "valueOfFnameAtRuntime". You can combine these criteria, even do a count with a name like countByFirstname or a limit with a name like findFirst3ByLastname…​

This means that results return quickly, but the data from the index may not yet contain data from previously written operations (called eventual consistency). items.source: Projections declare a contract between the underlying type and the method signatures related to the exposed properties. Hence it is required to name getter methods according to the property name of the underlying type. If the underlying property is named firstName, then the getter method must be named getFirstName otherwise Spring Data is not able to look up the source property.
items.translation: 投影声明了基础类型与所暴露属性相关的方法签名之间的契约。因此，必须根据基础类型的属性名称来命名 getter 方法。如果基础属性的名称为firstName，则 getter 方法的名称必须是getFirstName；否则，Spring Data 将无法查找源属性。

items.source: The goal of Spring Data repository abstraction is to significantly reduce the amount of boilerplate code required to implement data access layers for various persistence stores.
items.translation: Spring Data 仓储抽象的目标是显著减少为各种持久化存储实现数据访问层所需的样板代码量。

items.source:
By default, operations are backed by Key/Value if they are single-document operations and the ID is known.
For all other operations by default N1QL queries are generated, and as a result proper indexes must be created for performant data access.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果操作是单文档操作且已知 ID，则使用键值对进行存储。对于其他所有操作，默认会生成 N1QL 查询，因此必须创建适当的索引以实现高效的数据访问。

items.source: Also note that if you are running inside spring boot, the autoconfig support already sets up the annotation for you so you only need to use it if you want to override the defaults.

items.source:
Please note that this is just an interface and not an actual class.
In the background, when your context gets initialized, actual implementations for your repository descriptions get created and you can access them through regular beans.
This means you will save lots of boilerplate code while still exposing full CRUD semantics to your service layer and application.
items.translation:
请注意，这只是一个接口，而非实际的类。  
在后台，当您的上下文初始化时，会创建您仓库描述的实际实现，您可以通过常规 Bean 访问它们。  
这意味着您可以节省大量样板代码，同时仍向服务层和应用程序暴露完整的 CRUD 语义。

Spring Data Repositories usually return the domain model when using query methods.
However, sometimes, you may need to alter the view of that model for various reasons.
In this section, you will learn how to define projections to serve up simplified and reduced views of resources.

在本节中，您将学习如何定义投影，以提供资源的简化视图和精简视图。

items.source: We recommend that you always use the selectEntity SpEL and a WHERE clause with a filter SpEL (since otherwise your query could be impacted by entities from other repositories).
items.translation: 我们建议您始终使用 selectEntity SpEL 以及带有 filter SpEL 的 WHERE 子句（否则，您的查询可能会受到其他存储库中实体的影响）。

items.source: You can also use Page and Slice as method return types as well with a N1QL backed repository.
items.translation: 在使用基于 N1QL 的存储库时，您也可以将 Page 和 Slice 用作方法返回类型。

items.source: Actually the generated N1QL query will also contain an additional N1QL criteria in order to only select documents that match the repository’s entity class.
items.translation: 实际上，生成的 N1QL 查询还会包含额外的 N1QL 条件，以确保仅选择与存储库实体类匹配的文档。

items.source: If pageable and sort parameters are used with inline queries, there should not be any order by, limit or offset clause in the inline query itself otherwise the server would reject the query as malformed.
items.translation: 如果内联查询中使用了分页和排序参数，则内联查询本身不应包含 ORDER BY、LIMIT 或 OFFSET 子句，否则服务器会因查询格式错误而拒绝该查询。
